adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is normalized to lowercase (`map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`), but the check uses `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` where `guest` is not lowercased. Since the input schema (`z.string().email()`) and UI do not enforce lowercase, mixed-case variants (e.g., `Bad@Example.com`) can bypass `BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS`.
